sentences.text:
Opposite Parties
 Mr. Sanjay Rath, Aga
 Coram:

The Hon'Ble Dr. Justice S. K. Panigrahi
 Order Order
 No. 11.04.2025
01. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid  arrangement.

2. The Petitioner, by filing this Writ Petition, has challenged the action of the Opposite Party No.2/Food Safety Officer, Puri Municipality along with other Government Officers in sealing the meat shop of the Petitioner on 07.03.2025.

4. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that because of some viral videos uploaded in the social media by some miscreants, the Opposite Party No.2/ Food Safety Officer, Puri Municipality along with other officers rushed to the spot and sealed the meat spot and issued a notice on 07.03.2025.
However, the authority has not given any instruction on the sample taken by them till date.
5. In such premises, this Court directs the authority concerned to file a detail instruction within ten days from today.
6. In the meantime, learned counsel for the Petitioner is directed to implead Puri Municipality as a party to this Writ Petition.

7. List this matter on 17.04.2025.
Sheikh Babu vs State Of Odisha & Ors.
